verdict.rationale: Canva's docs describe its own bulk capability: bulk generation of personalized content from data, a 'Bulk create' feature, and automatic population of Brand Templates. That covers bulk creation, but there is no documented way to run bulk edits, exports, moves or deletes across many existing items, and each mention is a one-line summary. Missing for 10: bulk edit/export/delete across existing designs, batch API or MCP endpoints with documented limits, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Scale design output - generate personalized content in bulk using your own data and visuals.
Import data directly from third-party sources to use for design generation or Bulk create.
Automatically personalize and populate Brand Templates with real-time content from your data sources.
